'''Rers Shallit''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] who served on behalf of [[Morbo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Sometime during the war, he got together with [[Theron Shan]], son of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] and [[Jace Malcom]], who wanted to talk about [[Teff'ith]] to Morbo.
